text:
alex: T-minus 25 for routing-v2 deploy to prod. Quick rollcall and signoffs pls. No DB migration, config flag is `routing.v2.enabled=false` -> will flip to true. Canary 5% then 50% -> full.
priya: I can be smoke lead. Will run the latency and error-rate checks for the first canary. Has the metrics dashboard link been updated?
alex: yes sent in the runbook: https://playbook/internal/runbooks/routing-v2-deploy — dashboard panels under 'routing-v2' are ready.
maria: LGTM on the PRs, code review finished. Verified stress test locally at 1k rps.
sam: I reviewed the rollback playbook — if error-rate >1% for 2 consecutive minutes at canary, rollback immediately. I'll own rollback ops.
priya: I will run these commands as smoke owner:
```
# smoke checks
curl -sS https://prod.api.example.com/health | jq .status
curl -sS -H "x-canary:1" https://prod.api.example.com/route/test | jq .latency
```
priya: tagging the metrics I will monitor: `p95_latency`, `5xx_rate`, `error_budget_consumed`.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-18T15:00Z. Canary plan: 5% @ +2m, 50% @ +10m, 100% @ +30m. Rollback window enabled.
ops-oncall: I'll be reachable on phone and slack during rollout. Pager set to on-call. If anything odd ping @ops-oncall immediately.
alex: checklist before flip (please ack each):
- [ ] All PRs merged (maria)
- [ ] Smoke lead assigned (priya)
- [ ] Rollback owner assigned (sam)
- [ ] Runbook link shared (alex)
- [ ] Monitoring panels up (alex/priya)
- [ ] Final config toggle tested in staging (maria)

maria: ack on PRs and staging toggle tested.
priya: ack for smoke lead and panels ready.
sam: ack rollback owner.
alex: ok starting deploy in 10m. Small ask: if you see any unexplained 4xx spikes during canary, don't escalate unless it's >2x baseline — most are client-side.
priya: noted. I'll post a short smoke summary at each milestone (5%/50%/100%).
deploy-bot: Canary at 5% completed. Notifying #eng-releases.
priya: smoke @5%: p95 120ms (baseline 115ms), 5xx 0.02% -> good. No throttles observed.
sam: holding rollback channel open. No action.
deploy-bot: Canary at 50% completed.
priya: smoke @50%: p95 130ms, 5xx 0.05% -> still within SLO. Gradually watching for error-rate drift.
alex: thanks team. Proceeding to full rollout in 5m.
deploy-bot: Full rollout completed. Toggle `routing.v2.enabled=true` set.
priya: final smoke @100%: p95 135ms, 5xx 0.08% -> within acceptable delta. No rollback.
ops-oncall: confirming no pager alerts in the last 20m. Good job :thumbsup:
alex: great — closing this window. If anything crops up later please reopen thread.
